summary: Materialise NV filed a Form 6-K disclosing weekly progress of its share buyback program announced 30 October 2025, with a discretionary mandate to repurchase up to EUR 30 million. In the week of 15–19 June 2026, 46,152 shares were repurchased at an average EUR 5.82 per share (cash consideration). Since program start on 26 January 2026, 997,864 shares (1.7% of total outstanding) have been bought back for EUR 4.78 million. Repurchases are executed via Nasdaq order book; no cross or block trades. This is an ongoing open-market capital return program, not a tender offer. Watch cumulative purchases against the EUR 30 million ceiling and impact on EPS going forward.
